course_description:
This advanced course builds upon foundational psychological skills and focuses on specialised clinical skills in Cognitive Behaviour Therapy (CBT) and related evidence-based interventions. Students will dive deeper into cognitive skills training, as well as how to manage process issues, rupture and repair, and how to work with culturally and linguistically diverse populations. The course will also explore schema-focused therapy and compassion focused therapy. Emphasis is placed on developing competency in advanced therapy skills.

Advanced Cognitive Behaviour Therapies is delivered in the second semester of first year of postgraduate clinical training, and supports students' therapeutic skills development while they are completing their internal placements. The course will focus on the continued development and mastery of CBT, diving deeper into cognitive skills training and behavioural interventions. This will include how to move beyond template formulations to individualised case formulations. The course will then focus on process issues and how to manage ruptures and how to repair these in therapy. Additional therapy training in schema focused therapy and compassion focused therapy will also be provided. The course will focus on how to implement deliberate practice with self-reflection into training to improve skill development, which will be of strong emphasis in the tutorials. Students will also be provided with important training in how to apply CBT and other evidence-based therapy approaches with culturally and linguistically diverse populations. Across the course the aim is to deepen understanding and mastery of critical therapy skills, with opportunities for questions, demonstrations, and role plays.

course_aims:
This course aims to provide students with the advanced knowledge and professional skills needed to help with the mastery of cognitive behaviour therapy (CBT). Specifically, students will be:

a) trained to deepen their understanding, confidence and use of a range of evidence-based CBT strategies

b) able to apply deliberate practice strategies with self-reflection to improve competency skill development

c) able to notice and navigate moments of therapeutic rupture so that these can be attended to and repaired

d) able to appraise the effectiveness of their use of therapeutic strategies, showing their continued application of the scientist-practitioner model.

learning_outcomes.description: Deepen understanding and mastery of CBT skills
Apply deliberate practice strategies to improve therapeutic skill development
Engage in reflective and reflexive practice, as well as self-care
Manage process issues in therapy (e.g., working to repair therapeutic ruptures and working with shame)
Able to apply CBT with culturally and linguistically diverse populations
Able to continue to apply the scientist-practitioner model to your therapy practice.

learning_activities.topic: Intro to Advanced CBT Introduction to the course, reflecting on CBT skill development and deliberate practice
Mastering Levels of Cognition Diving deeper into levels of cognition and how to work with each level of cognition
Deliberate Practice Setting up the conditions to make deliberate practice work
Mastering Behavioural Interventions Diving deeper into specific behavioural interventions and setting up rationales
Process Issues Being able to identify sources of difficulty in therapy, such as shame, and learning how to work with this in therapy Learning outcomes: L01
Role Plays: Individualised Case Formulations Role play opportunity on developing individualised case formulations
Managing Rupture & Repair Being able to identify and repair withdrawal and confrontation ruptures
Role Plays: Socratic Questioning Role play opportunities on working with Socratic Questioning frameworks
In Class Quiz In class quiz
Schema Therapy: Part 1 Focus will be on Harnessing Experiential Techniques specifically on: 1.Limited Reparenting & Imagery Rescripting
Role Plays: Limited Reparenting & Imagery Rescripting Role play opportunity to practice core schema therapy exercises
Schema Therapy: Part 2 Focus will be on Harnessing Experiential Techniques, with a specific focus on: Chairwork & Empathic Confrontation
Role Plays: Chairwork & Empathic Confrontation Role play opportunities on core schema therapy exercises
Compassion Focused Therapy: Part 1 Focus on introducing CFT, specifically the tripartite model of emotion regulation
Role Plays: Three Circle Model Role Play opportunity on core CFT skills
Mid-Semester Break Mid-Semester Break
Compassion Focused Therapy: Part 2 Focus on specific practices, such as mindfulness and breathing to grow green circle
Role Plays: Growing Green Role play opportunity on how to grow green circle
Working with Culturally and Linguistically Diverse Populations with CBT: Part 1 Issues to be aware of when seeing clients with Culturally and Linguistically Diverse Populations when using CBT
Role Plays: Competency Practice on Process Issue Role play opportunity on managing a process issue

Working with Culturally and Linguistically Diverse Populations with CBT: Part 2 Tips and strategies you can use to improve CBT when seeing clients with Culturally and Linguistically Diverse backgrounds
Role Plays: Competency Practice on Process Issue Role play opportunity on managing a process issue
Competency Exam: Role Play Role play opportunity on managing a process issue
Wrap Up & Final Prep for Competency Assessment Reviewing the course, checking-in with CBT skills competency confidence
